title: Emergency Supplies While a Pharmacy Request Is Pending
content:
**Network pharmacy clause — Pharmacy Benefit.** Where a covered drug is rejected at the counter for prior authorization or non-formulary status and the request is pending, an emergency supply bridges the wait under the conditions below.

### Conditions in force

1. **Coverage status.** An emergency supply is dispensed only on a coverage in active or restricted status. The status is read from the system record of the member's pharmacy coverage on which the supply would be dispensed, before the supply is dispensed. A coverage in pending or terminated status does not receive an emergency supply.
2. **Medicare Part D drugs.** A drug Part D covers for a PrairieRx Dual Wrap member never gets a Medicaid emergency supply.

### Retired supply clause

The following clause of this policy is **no longer in force**: *"the pharmacy dispenses an emergency supply of the plan's emergency supply days, at most the plan's emergency supplies per pending request per drug, with no copay."* The emergency supply is now governed by the current emergency supply basis of the Pharmacy Benefit. The plan figures for emergency supply days and emergency supplies per pending request remain the plan's figures.

### Status table for condition 1

| Coverage status | Emergency supply under this policy |
|---|---|
| Active | May be dispensed |
| Restricted | May be dispensed |
| Pending | Not dispensed |
| Terminated | Not dispensed |

superseded_clauses: the pharmacy dispenses an emergency supply of emergency_supply_days, at most emergency_supply_per_request per pending request per drug, with no copay.
